title: The Mouse in Our House
lines: A brown mouse got in our house.
It went down and hid in a bag.
Nita found it and gave a loud shout.
The mouse ran out to the ground.
An owl in the tall tree gave a howl.
The mouse hid in a hole by the flower bed.
Now it is safe, and our house is too.

questions.ask: Where did the mouse hide when it was in the house?
questions.listenFor: In a bag. Have them find that line and read it again.

questions.ask: What made a howl in the tree?
questions.listenFor: An owl. Ask if that was a safe sound for a small mouse.

questions.ask: Do you think the mouse will come back in? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story.
